trigger: Player steps onto the first vanishing cache block in Room 05.

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: Zero bytes remaining! The platform dissolved right under my sneakers!

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: I threw ten thousand credits at the drive, but it still says disk full.

lines.speaker: sehaj
lines.text: Don't buy cloud storage. If a block drops you, swap to me and I'll rewind it.
